title: Title card now shows the words, a check against the frame, and hand controls that draw at once
why: reads “Copper Mountain · February 2026”, ✓ checked · inside the frame; words / size / x-y / in-out / Fit to frame with a dashed title-safe line on the monitor; changes drew in under 2 s and the check re-ran in 6 s with no model call. This is what I asked for last round.

title: Asking for transitions in words works and is honest about handles
why: "add a 12-frame cross dissolve between shot 9 and shot 10, and a 1-second dip to black before the last shot" came back in 8 s as two tickable edits with exact durations, and it told me shot 10 has no spare footage before its in point. The dissolve then showed in the Program monitor parked on the edit.

title: Export can be put away and says exactly which cut it is rendering
why: 'This is an export of the cut as it was at 12:02 PM. Edits you make while it renders are not in this file.' + Keep working. I scaled shot 11 to 150 % mid-render and the file has it at 100 %, as promised. Done dialog has Download / Play / Show file with a Copy path box.
